{{% callout type="info" %}}
**Where to find it:** Applications & Components → Comma → Model Edit → `uCombinePlate` (also on the Comma ribbon tab, Model Edit group)
{{% /callout %}}

Merges contour plates: the first selected plate is kept and the second is removed after a checked merge.

**How to use:**

1.  Select the contour plates in order, then click **Apply**.
2.  Extra selections are combined one pair at a time. Pick a new plate when one remains; <kbd>Esc</kbd> ends.

The original chamfers are replaced by the evaluated polygon vertices (with no chamfer).

{{% callout type="warning" %}}
If a write fails, the command stops and reports possible partial changes; inspect and Undo before retrying. A failure while cleaning up the operative objects can leave objects that need inspection.
{{% /callout %}}

**More details:**

-   Additional selections form a pair queue.
-   Operative cleanup failures can leave objects requiring inspection.
